instruction: I would like to use GIMP alone to download the Columbia University emblem from their website in JPEG format, without launching an external browser.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible as GIMP does not include functionality for downloading files from the internet. It is designed exclusively for image editing.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - GIMP is an image editing application and does not have functionality to download files from the internet
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate choice for impossible tasks
Metadata explanation accurately describes why the task cannot be completed
No verification logic is needed since the task itself is impossible to complete with GIMP alone
